title: Arithmetic counts for the Gamma0 coset action
statement: Let N be a nonzero natural number, G=SL₂(ℤ), H=Γ₀(N), and Q=G/H with left multiplication. Put S=((0,−1),(1,0)), T=((1,1),(0,1)), μ=∑_{d∣N, d squarefree}N/d, e₂=#{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+1=0}, e₃=#{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+x+1=0}, and c=∑_{d∣N}φ(gcd(d,N/d)), where φ is Euler's totient. Then Q is finite, |Q|=μ, S has e₂ fixed points, ST has e₃ fixed points, and the subgroup generated by T has c orbits on Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Finite Q ∧ Nat.card Q = ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N ∧ Nat.card {q : Q // ModularGroup.S • q = q} = ModularCurve.nuTwo N ∧ Nat.card {q : Q // (ModularGroup.S * ModularGroup.T) • q = q} = ModularCurve.nuThree N ∧ Nat.card (Quotient (MulAction.orbitRel (Subgroup.zpowers ModularGroup.T) Q)) = ModularCurve.cuspCount N
